facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at P-3223

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ENERGY_SOURCE_IDENTIFICATION: the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the identification of every energy source for the task on P-3223 and PT-3223 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. P-3223 (slurry transfer pumps) is in service for cyclone feed and tailings transfer. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the identification of every energy source for the task was in place but did not perform. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 28 February 2022 a planned assurance activity of P-3223 and PT-3223 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the identification of every energy source for the task not effective.
